question: The Bhotia dance form is a folk-dance from which of the following Indian states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhotia dance form** is a traditional folk dance from the Indian state of **Uttarakhand**.
 
• This dance is performed by the Bhotia community, who reside in the higher altitudes of the state.
 
• The dance is characterized by its energetic and vibrant movements, often performed during festivals and special occasions.
 
• Bhotia dance reflects the rich cultural heritage and traditions of the Bhotia tribe.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uttarakhand** is known for its diverse and vibrant cultural traditions, including various folk dances and music forms.
 
• Other notable folk dances from Uttarakhand include **Chholiya, Jhora, and Barada Nati**.
 
• The state is often referred to as the "Land of Gods" due to its numerous Hindu temples and pilgrimage sites.
 
• Uttarakhand was carved out of the northern part of Uttar Pradesh on **9th November 2000**.
 
• It is famous for its scenic beauty, with the Himalayas, rivers, and forests adding to its picturesque landscape.
